rccg_open_heavens.title: Open Heavens Daily Devotional
rccg_open_heavens.author: Pastor E.A. Adeboye
rccg_open_heavens.memoryVerseText: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
message: Favor is the supernatural fragrance that attracts unmerited blessings into the life of a believer. When God's favor rests upon an ordinary person, human protocols are suspended for their sake.
Queen Esther was a simple captive orphan in Shushan, yet when the oil of divine favor touched her countenance, she found favor in the sight of all that looked upon her.
Stay rooted in holiness, prayer, and humility, and watch God open doors no mortal can shut.
prayerPoints: Father, let Your set time of divine favor locate my destiny today in Jesus' name.
Lord, let Your favor surround me like a shield wherever I go.
rccg_open_heavens.hymn: Hymn 26: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Saviour

mfm_mfm.title: Mountain Top Life Daily Devotional
mfm_mfm.author: Dr. D.K. Olukoya
mfm_mfm.motivationalQuote: Get rid of that stain that makes you a stench in God's nostrils.
mfm_mfm.propheticWord: God will purge you of all impurities, in the Name of Jesus.
message: The third prerequisite a vessel must meet to be used by God is that it must be clean. A cup that is dirty will not be used by anyone to drink water, no matter how thirsty the person is. As an unclean cup is unhygienic and harmful to health, so will an unclean vessel turn out to be a liability in spiritual affairs. God is holy; He cannot use unclean, filthy instruments.

Impurity in the form of sinfulness is fundamentally against God's holy nature. God cannot use an unclean, double-minded person. God had to expose and deal with the uncleanness in Isaiah's life before He used him greatly as a messianic prophet. In (Isaiah 6:5), Isaiah acknowledged that he was a man of unclean lips.

Perhaps it is the laboratory of your heart that needs cleansing. Many allow lust, evil thoughts, bitterness, and secret grudges to flow unchecked. Whatever it is that has made you a vessel unto dishonour, you can turn to God today and the touch of His purging fire will cleanse and sanctify you spirit, soul, and body (1 John 1:9).
morningPrayers: Anointing of holiness and spiritual purity, fall upon me now, in the name of Jesus.
Blood of Jesus, purge my heart, my mind, and my thoughts, in Jesus' name.
eveningPrayers: O God, arise and make me a vessel unto honour, sanctified and meet for Your use.
Holy Ghost fire, consume every root of secret compromise in my life, in Jesus' name.

dclm_dclm.title: DCLM Daily Manna
dclm_dclm.author: Pastor W.F. Kumuyi
dclm_dclm.thoughtForTheDay: True meaning and lasting satisfaction are found only in the unchanging God.
message: Human history, for all its dazzling scientific advancements and technological novelties, repeats itself in basic spiritual and moral patterns. Fashion styles from decades ago are recycled as 'latest trends'. Political systems rise and fall upon the same ambitions and frailties.

King Solomon, endowed with unrivaled wisdom and boundless wealth, explored all earthly pursuits—wealth, architecture, knowledge, sensory pleasure, and fame. Yet in (Ecclesiastes 1:9), he arrived at an unflinching conclusion: 'The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.'

Worldly achievements without God are empty bubbles that burst at the touch of eternity. Those who chase after the fleeting pleasures of this world inevitably discover the bitter vanity at their core (1 John 2:17).
Beloved, let your heart find its rest in Christ Jesus, the same yesterday, today, and forever (Hebrews 13:8). Build your life upon His enduring Word.
prayerPoints: Lord, deliver me from the deceptive vanity and distractions of this present world.
Father, anchor my soul firmly in Your unchanging Word and righteousness, in Jesus' name.

rccg_rccg_ss_adult.title: RCCG Sunday School (Adult Students)
rccg_rccg_ss_adult.memoryVerseText: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost.
rccg_rccg_ss_adult.introduction: Water baptism is a cardinal ordinance in Christianity instituted by Jesus Christ for every believer who has surrendered their life to Him.

outlines.title: Outline 1: Significance and Biblical Mode of Baptism
points: 1. Baptism by immersion symbolizes identification with Christ's death, burial, and resurrection (Romans 6:3-4).
2. It is a public confession of internal transformation through faith in Christ Jesus (Galatians 3:27).

outlines.title: Outline 2: Prerequisites and Spiritual Impact
points: 1. Genuine repentance and faith in Jesus Christ are prerequisites (Mark 16:16).
2. Water baptism does not save by itself; it seals the believer's covenant walk with God (1 Peter 3:21).

rccg_rccg_ss_adult.discussion: Why did Jesus, who knew no sin, submit Himself to John's baptism in Jordan?
rccg_rccg_ss_adult.summary: Water baptism is non-negotiable for true discipleship.
rccg_rccg_ss_adult.assignment: Witness to one unsaved person and encourage a newly converted believer to enroll for water baptism classes.

christ_embassy_rhapsody.title: Rhapsody of Realities
christ_embassy_rhapsody.author: Pastor Chris Oyakhilome
christ_embassy_rhapsody.memoryVerseText: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
christ_embassy_rhapsody.confession: I am born from above! The incorruptible life of God works mightily in my spirit. I walk in divine vitality and victory daily in Christ Jesus!
message: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the Word of God which liveth and abideth forever! Hallelujah! In (1 Peter 1:23), God reveals the supernatural origin of your new life.
This means failure, sickness, fear, and spiritual death have zero legal jurisdiction over your physical body and circumstances (2 Corinthians 5:17).
The Word of God is your spiritual mirror. Look into it daily and align your confessions with what God says about you. Speak the Word boldly!

odm_odm.title: Our Daily Manna
odm_odm.author: Bishop Dr. Chris Kwakpovwe
odm_odm.memoryVerseText: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
odm_odm.devotionalCapsule: When God is ready to perform His wonders, protocols are suspended and mockers are silenced!
message: Beloved, our God is never late! Even when the clock of life appears to have ticked to the final second and your adversaries have already written your spiritual obituary, Jehovah El-Shaddai steps into the arena and reverses the irreversible! (Psalm 126:1).
Don't lose your joy because of temporary setbacks or stubborn delays. Delay is never denial in God's kingdom agenda. Hold on to your faith!
God is setting an ambush against your adversaries, and your mockers shall soon gather to congratulate you!
prayerPoints: O God of eleventh-hour miracles, arise and turn my captivity around this month, in Jesus' name.
Every power assigned to prolong my struggle, expire by fire, in the name of Jesus.
